body: @alextreseder - you mentioned on Discord that you are building a DIY EDM with the G-EDM spark generator and motion control. This issue collects what CamCraft needs to make wire programs for it. When you have time, the questions under "What would help" are the most useful: which G-EDM electronics and firmware you run, whether your build is wire, sinker or both, and a short wire program your G-EDM accepts. We use only public documentation and what you tell us, never the G-EDM firmware code (its licence is private-use only).

## Research summary

This research checks public G-EDM documentation (`gedm.org`, `github.com/G-EDM/G-RBL`, `github.com/alextreseder/WEDM`, `hackaday.io/project/190371-g-edm`), public `Grbl_Esp32` G-code documentation, and our CamCraft source code. We read no `G-RBLv3` source files and no Autodesk materials.

## Answers to open questions

### 1. G-code subset for wire EDM

- **Units and distance modes:** Public `Grbl_Esp32` documentation lists `G20` (inches), `G21` (millimetres), `G90` (absolute), and `G91` (incremental). `gedm.org` states that G-EDM wire mode reads FreeCAD GRBL output and ignores `Z` words in 2D mode.
- **Pre-offset paths only:** Public `Grbl_Esp32` documentation states that `G41` and `G42` (wire radius compensation) are unsupported and return an error. `Grbl_Esp32` accepts `G40` only as a cancel no-op. CamCraft already computes the pre-offset wire-centre path in `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/mod.rs`.
- **Linear and circular moves:** `gedm.org` states that wire mode runs `G0`, `G1`, `G2`, and `G3` 2D contours. Public `Grbl_Esp32` documentation accepts `G17` arcs with incremental `I`/`J` (`G91.1`) or `R`. Today `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/mod.rs` emits straight `Feed` moves only, and `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps` emits `G2`/`G3` with `I`/`J`.
- **Comments and program framing:** `Grbl_Esp32` accepts `(...)` comments (no nesting) and `;` comments, plus `M2` or `M30` to end the program. Raw Grbl parsers reject bare `%` tape fences (`error:20`), so `assets/posts/grblhal.cps` omits `%` and `O`-words. `gedm.org` also recommends a final return move to `X0 Y0` so the operator can remove the part safely.
- **Unconfirmed on `G-RBLv3`:** We still need the reporter to confirm whether `G-RBLv3` keeps `G40`, `G91.1`, `G54`–`G59`, `G20`, and `M30` vs `M2`, and whether it strips or rejects `%`.

### 2. 2-axis (XY) vs 4-axis (XYUV)

- **Public evidence:** `github.com/G-EDM/G-RBL` documents 3+1 axis router builds (2D `XY` wire mode). Both `gedm.org` and `hackaday.io/project/190371-g-edm` also document modular `XYUV` and `XYUVZ` builds, including Alex Treseder's `XYUVZ` wire machine with linked `XU`/`YV` jogging.
- **CamCraft today:** `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs` and `crates/app/src/machine/wire_edm.rs` already support `X`, `Y`, `U`, and `V` axes on `wire_edm` machines. `crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs` (`guided`) outputs lower-guide `X`/`Y` positions and `WireU`/`WireV` offsets from the lower guide.
- **Unconfirmed on `G-RBLv3`:** We do not know whether `G-RBLv3` reads `U`/`V` as offsets from `X`/`Y` (like `WireU`/`WireV`) or as absolute upper-guide coordinates, nor whether stock `G-RBLv3` enables `U`/`V` by default. Like `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps` (`#1497`), the first post slice cuts 2-axis `XY` only and refuses taper and 4-axis cuts until confirmed.

### 3. Meaning of `F` and M-codes

- **Feed (`F`):** `gedm.org` states that wire mode ignores `F` words from CAM files. The firmware controls feed, feed hold, and short-circuit retraction from gap voltage feedback (`vFd`).
- **Grbl parser hazard:** Standard Grbl throws `error:22` when a `G1` block runs before any modal `F` value is set. `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps` omits `F` on `G1` (`crates/motion/src/wire_edm/mod.rs`). We must confirm whether `G-RBLv3` accepts bare `G1 X.. Y..` or requires an initial `F` word.
- **M-codes:** `gedm.org` states that the firmware switches the DC power supply (DPM8605 / DPH8909) on at job start and off at job end. Hardware or firmware settings control wire tension (`github.com/alextreseder/WEDM` closed-loop torque stepper), wire feed, and flushing. `crates/post/src/machine/edm.rs` (`EDM_HEAD`) forbids `coolants` lists on `wire_edm` machines. We must confirm whether `G-RBLv3` reads any M-codes (`M3`/`M5`, `M8`/`M9`, `M0`) or none.

### 4. Mapping CamCraft's Wire Contour, kerf offset, and skims

- **`WireContourOp` maps well geometrically:** Since `G-RBLv3` lacks `G41`/`G42`, CamCraft must calculate the wire-centre path (`wire_radius + gap`). Today `crates/app/src/operation/wire_op.rs` (`#2011`) reads `wire_diameter` from a mounted `ToolKind::Wire` tool and `gap` from `machine.edm.conditions[]` (`crates/post/src/machine/edm_conditions.rs`). CamCraft never models pulse power (`#531`).
- **Why `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps` fails for G-EDM:** `wire-iso.cps` requires `edm.codes.condition` (with `{id}`) and `edm.codes.comp_off` (`REQUIRED`), and writes `%` tape fences. A G-EDM build that sets power at the panel has no condition G-code word, so `wire-iso.cps` refuses it.
- **Resulting model:** Keep `ToolKind::Wire` plus user-entered `edm.conditions[]` for the spark gap (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_edm.rs`). Add a dedicated `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` post that writes the condition id in a comment only.
- **Skims:** `crates/app/src/operation/wire_op.rs` and `crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs` support multi-pass skims on one path (`#538`). Because G-EDM cannot switch generator power via G-code, the initial `g-edm.cps` refuses skims by name (like `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps`) until the reporter confirms whether an `M00` pause between passes is wanted.

### 5. Sinker EDM scope

- **Out of scope for NC post output:** `gedm.org` and `github.com/G-EDM/G-RBL` state that G-EDM sinker jobs use no G-code because the firmware drives probing, plunging, jump retracts, and flushing itself.
- **Existing CamCraft sinker path:** `crates/app/src/operation/types/sinker.rs` and `assets/posts/sinker-iso.cps` generate Z-plunge G-code and require `edm.codes`. Only a future XY hole-location export would fit G-EDM sinker builds, and that sits outside this wire EDM post scope.

### 6. Machine-file data needed

- **Unstated-limits law (`assets/machines/AGENTS.md`, `#1501`):** Never ship invented travels, guide heights, or spark-gap conditions for DIY builds.
- **Generic G-EDM template (`g-edm.mch`):** Set `general.kind = "wire_edm"`, linear `X` and `Y` axes, `"type": "head"` `"guides"`, `edm.awt = false`, no `edm.codes`, and no travels or `edm.conditions` (matching `assets/machines/sinker-edm.mch` and `assets/machines/sodick-alc400g.mch`). Users enter their own travels and measured spark gaps in the Machine editor (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_edm.rs`).
- **Build-specific data:** `github.com/alextreseder/WEDM` (`picoEDM`) publishes `160 x 160 mm` XY travel (`50 mm` Z), but omits guide heights (`edm.lower_guide_z`, `edm.upper_guide_z`), wire diameters, and `edm.max_taper_deg`. Those fields stay unstated until confirmed (`crates/app/src/machine/wire_edm.rs` requires them before any taper cut).

## Design proposal (smallest useful first slice first)

1. **Slice 1 — 2-axis `g-edm.cps` wire post:** Add `assets/posts/g-edm.cps`, register `"G-EDM Wire EDM"` in `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (`BUILTINS`, `WIRE_POSTS`) and `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` (`embedded`), and add golden and refusal tests in `crates/app/tests/` and `crates/post/tests/`. Keep `Generic ISO Wire EDM` as the default. Emit `G20`/`G21`, `G90`, `G17`, `G0`, `G1`, `G2`/`G3` (`I`/`J`), `(...)` comments, and `M30` with no `%` fence and no required `edm.codes`. Mark output `(NOT VERIFIED ON A CONTROL - CHECK BEFORE CUTTING)`, and refuse taper, 4-axis, skims, `G41`/`G42`, and non-`wire_edm` machines by name.
2. **Slice 2 — `g-edm.mch` machine template:** Add `assets/machines/g-edm.mch` to `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (`MACHINES`) and `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` (`embedded`), validated by `crates/app/tests/machine_library.rs`.
3. **Slice 3 — XYUV taper and 4-axis support (after firmware confirmation):** Once the reporter confirms `U`/`V` coordinate semantics (`WireU`/`WireV` offset vs absolute) and mode words on `G-RBLv3`, enable taper (`#536`) and 4-axis ruled cuts (`#537`, `#2690`) in `g-edm.cps` and add a `U`/`V` machine preset if travels and guide heights are confirmed.
4. **Slice 4 — Confirmed M-codes, feed word check, and manual skim pauses:** Once the reporter confirms `G1` `F`-word behavior (`error:22`), spark/pump M-codes, and `M00` workflow, add confirmed M-codes and optional `M00` skim pauses (or document permanent refusals).

## Concrete sub-issues

1. **G-EDM: add 2-axis wire EDM post (g-edm.cps) for G-RBLv3**
   - Adds `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` (`G-EDM Wire EDM` in `BUILTINS` and `WIRE_POSTS`) for 2-axis pre-offset wire paths without requiring `edm.codes`, and locks goldens and refusals.
   - Done means: `g-edm.cps` posts a 2-axis `WireContour` golden without `edm.codes`, refuses non-`wire_edm` machines, `G41`/`G42`, taper, 4-axis, skims, and mill goldens by name, and `cargo xtask gate test g_edm --crate camcraft-app` plus `script_g_edm` pass.
   - Proposed: `P6` · `effort:high` · `area:post`

2. **G-EDM: add wire EDM machine template (g-edm.mch) to the library**
   - Adds `assets/machines/g-edm.mch` (`G-EDM Wire EDM (template)` in `MACHINES`) with `X`/`Y` axes, `edm.awt: false`, and no invented travels or spark-gap conditions.
   - Done means: `G-EDM Wire EDM (template)` passes `machine_library` validation, pairs with `G-EDM Wire EDM` in `post_serves`, refuses `WireContour` until a user adds a condition (`#531`), and posts a golden with a synthetic test condition.
   - Proposed: `P6` · `effort:medium` · `area:post`

3. **G-EDM: add XYUV taper and 4-axis ruled wire post support**
   - Extends `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` to emit `U` and `V` moves for constant taper (`#536`) and 4-axis ruled cuts (`#537`) after `G-RBLv3` `U`/`V` semantics are confirmed on `#2697`.
   - Done means: Tapered and 4-axis `WireContour` cuts post golden `.nc` files on a `U`/`V`-capable G-EDM machine with confirmed `U`/`V` semantics, 2-axis machines and tapered arcs refuse by name, and tests in `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-post` pass.
   - Proposed: `P6` · `effort:high` · `area:post`, `area:multiaxis`

4. **G-EDM: add confirmed M-codes and manual skim pauses to g-edm.cps**
   - Adds firmware-confirmed spark/pump/wire M-codes, feed-word handling (`error:22` check), and safe `M00` power-change pauses for skim passes (`#538`) to `assets/posts/g-edm.cps`, or keeps explicit named refusals.
   - Done means: `g-edm.cps` emits confirmed M-codes and `M00` skim pauses pinned by golden tests or keeps explicit named refusals in `docs/decisions/`, and `cargo xtask gate test g_edm` passes.
   - Proposed: `P7` · `effort:high` · `area:post`

Filed sub-issues for #2697 (kept open for maintainer review):

- #2700 — G-EDM: add 2-axis wire EDM post (g-edm.cps) for G-RBLv3 (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
- #2701 — G-EDM: add wire EDM machine template (g-edm.mch) to the library (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`)
- #2702 — G-EDM: add XYUV taper and 4-axis ruled wire post support (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `area:multiaxis`)
- #2703 — G-EDM: add confirmed M-codes and manual skim pauses to g-edm.cps (`P7`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
